title: The Rise of Atheism: Best Books & Movies on Atheism
tags: christopher hitchens god is not great
description:
Looking for the best books and movies on atheism? Whether you’re an atheist, agnostic, or a theist curious about different perspectives, this video dives into a rich list of resources to expand your mind.

We cover the classics of modern atheism: Richard Dawkins’s The God Delusion, Christopher Hitchens’s God is Not Great, Daniel Dennett’s Breaking the Spell, Sam Harris’s The End of Faith and Letter to a Christian Nation, and Bertrand Russell’s Why I Am Not a Christian. We also explore works like Why I Am Not a Muslim by Ibn Warraq, Why People Believe Weird Things by Michael Shermer, Flim Flam by James Randi, and The Atheist’s Guide to Christmas.

Indian rationalist voices are not left out: Bhagat Singh’s Why I Am an Atheist, B.R. Ambedkar’s Riddles in Hinduism, Abraham Kovoor’s writings, Joseph Edamaruku’s critiques, and the works of Narendra Dabholkar, Govind Pansare, M.M. Kalburgi, Gauri Lankesh, Ravichandran C, and Tomy Sebastian. These voices shaped the Indian atheist movement despite facing violent backlash.

We also highlight Carl Sagan’s Cosmos and Demon-Haunted World, which champion critical thinking and inspired this channel’s name, Pale Blue Thoughts.

On the big screen, Hollywood has brought atheism and skepticism to life with films like The Ledge, Religulous, The God Who Wasn’t There, Creation, Paul, The Invention of Lying, Kumare, The Unbelievers, and Agora. Indian cinema has flirted with atheism through films like OMG, PK, Prabhuvinte Makkal, and Nirmalyam, though often watered down by religious concessions.

If you’ve searched for best atheist books, atheist movies list, Richard Dawkins The God Delusion, Christopher Hitchens God is Not Great, Sam Harris The End of Faith, Bertrand Russell Why I Am Not a Christian, atheist documentaries, or atheist cinema, this video has it all.
